title: Risk Fusion Safety Policy
description: Policy-driven thresholds for correlating medication changes with mood patterns

activation.note: Detects paradoxical worsening within 3-10 days of SSRI/SNRI start

worsening.note: Triggers alert if mood drops by 0.2+ points after medication change

nonadherence.note: Flags patients who haven't checked in for 7+ days AND have open tasks

disclaimers: These are decision support thresholds, not diagnostic criteria
Provider must review all alerts and use clinical judgment
Adjust thresholds based on institutional needs
Consider patient-specific factors (e.g., bipolar disorder risk)
